problem_text:
A hospital has 7 patients who need to undergo 7 different medical tests.

Each patient's treatment plan consists of a sequence of tests represented as pairs (Testing Equipment, Duration), where each pair specifies the medical equipment required for the test and the time needed to complete it. The order of pairs indicates the required sequence in which the tests must be performed.

Patient details:
* P1 requires the sequence: (E4, 9) → (E7, 3) → (E5, 4) → (E1, 10) → (E3, 3) → (E2, 2) → (E6, 10)
* P2 requires the sequence: (E4, 1) → (E3, 9) → (E6, 2) → (E5, 1) → (E1, 5) → (E2, 3) → (E7, 3)
* P3 requires the sequence: (E7, 3) → (E5, 6) → (E2, 10) → (E1, 2) → (E6, 2) → (E4, 6) → (E3, 4)
* P4 requires the sequence: (E3, 6) → (E4, 8) → (E7, 7) → (E6, 7) → (E2, 9) → (E1, 8) → (E5, 9)
* P5 requires the sequence: (E4, 3) → (E5, 2) → (E1, 3) → (E2, 3) → (E6, 1) → (E7, 7) → (E3, 10)
* P6 requires the sequence: (E1, 8) → (E6, 7) → (E7, 10) → (E3, 6) → (E4, 10) → (E2, 8) → (E5, 9)
* P7 requires the sequence: (E3, 6) → (E2, 9) → (E5, 1) → (E1, 4) → (E7, 10) → (E6, 2) → (E4, 8)

Each test must run continuously once it begins and cannot be interrupted, and each piece of testing equipment can only handle one patient at a time. The objective is to determine the scheduling order of all tests on the equipment so that the total completion time for all patients is minimized.
